dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive, symmetrical reduction in lateral width from the mid-dorsal region to the distal peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized symmetrical indentations at the junction where the main body mass meets the narrower tail peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the majority of the visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A singular, low-intensity longitudinal line is centered on the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Longitudinal dark linear marking visible along the central dorsal axis.
